exposure: Deliveries with and without epidural analgesia
Deliveries with and without labor induction
cohort: 78,292 women with singleton pregnancies at ≥37 weeks gestation in cephalic presentation who had ≥2 documented cervical examinations during labor, including 10,532 grand multiparous women and 67,760 multiparous women
finding: Cervical dilation progression during the active phase of labor was similar between grand multiparous and multiparous women, while head descent and second stage of labor duration were shorter in grand multiparous women.
